# OCR Web Service

OCR Web Service provides SOAP and REST APIs for integrating Optical Character Recognition (OCR) technology into software products, mobile devices, or other web services.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/ocr-web-service/.

## Actions

- **Get Account Information** (read-only): Retrieve current account details such as remaining pages, subscription plan, and expiration date.
- **OCRWebService Recognize** (read-only): Call soap recognize operation.
- **Get Account Credentials** (read-only): Extract ocrwebservice credentials.
- **OCR Web Service Log** (read-only): Retrieve ocr processing logs.
